headline: Romania attracted 5.4% of the investment volume in real estate in the six most important economies in the region
summary: Romania's real estate investment market recorded transactions of about 300 million euros in the first half of 2026, down from the previous year. The country accounted for 5.4% of investment volume across six major regional economies.
why: Real estate transaction volumes are a key gauge of commercial property demand and credit conditions. Investors use them to assess returns and risk in emerging European markets.
